steps.text: Meanwhile, on the other side of the slums...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Calm down! Say it again slowly.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: B- but... all of them... they're all dead!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What's happening? What happened? I can't see! I can't see anything!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Say again!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Report!
...phew.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...that smell. Don't panic! Everyone's still here!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Listen up!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aaah! It's red! I saw it! I saw the red!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Calm him down!
... (Inhuman laughing).

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I... I want to go home... I want to go back to Ursus...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: There's ghosts here! And monsters! I saw the shadows... of two women!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aaaaaagh! I want to go home!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We shouldn't have come, Crownslayer!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Do you copy? Answer me!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The layout of these slums is confusing, but don't let the enemy confuse you. We are perfectly safe!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (How is our position still exposed with all the fog?)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: There remains the traitor's position. I am aware.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: She is in Lungmen. Kill her. Make a name for yourself that your enemies should fear.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: After you've killed your rival, then what? Don't forget your true enemy.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ——Who?!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Bring her to me!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Sorry, Swire, bring you who?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Bring her to me!!!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Erm?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: (Who is she talking about?)

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: (I don't know, maybe...)

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: That pink-haired sewer scum! Dial 100800-00200-rct211-93001! That's her number!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: (How did she memorize a number that long?)

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: (That number is familiar... Is it that one lady...?)

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What are you two whispering about?!
Hello.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What are you up to, you filthy rat?! What have you done?!
And why do you suspect me?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm glad it wasn't you. Phew. You had me worried there...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Suspect you of what?
If you're talking about the special forces, that was me.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Lin Yühsia, I think I misheard something. I misheard you, didn't I?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The L. G. D. has its business, and we have ours.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Wei Yenwu has you to keep order in Lungmen, and we are here to remove that which Lungmen does not need.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You know what this team did in the slums?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: They helped you deal with Reunion quite efficiently.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: That buffer zone was your father's blood, sweat, and tears!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: It's all thanks to him and his work in the slums that Lungmen is what it is today!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Do you know their objective?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You've made it very clear. The slums are full of places for Reunion to hide, not to mention their invasion route. You'd level them!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Isn't that right?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: We're working with Rhodes Island now. Reunion is no match for us! You don't have to do this!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Jumping to conclusions before I even have a chance to explain...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: While Reunion is certainly no match for us, they're still not a problem for civilian forces to solve.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We must use the true power of our city to eradicate this threat. This is how I face the invaders.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Why can't you put your faith in Rhodes Island and our own L. G. D.?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Why should we trust Rhodes Island? And why dirty the hands of the L. G. D.?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What do you mean dirty...?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Don't tell me you had no other choice. That's your father's land.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: It takes so much more to build than to destroy!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Breaking a pane of glass takes one person one second... Do you know how long it takes to make one? How many people are involved?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Swire.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Do you know what it is the people fear? Do you know what it is that scares the chambers of commerce?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What's wrong with you? Aren't we facing off against Reunion?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You really don't understand at all.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Fine. Filthy rat... I don't understand. Might I humble myself and request that you grace me with an explanation?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The Infected... are growing in number. The people fear the Infected, and they don't care if they're Reunion or not.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: In short, don't go looking in the sewers.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hello? Are you there?! Stinking, shit-eating rat!!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You dare hang up on me! Sei puk gaai syu ah! How dare you hang up on me?!!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Ch'en chased off the Black Cloaks?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What to do about that...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: They'll move past her, and accelerate the pace. Hm, that will do.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad, if you were me, if the younger you were me, this is what you'd do too, isn't it?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: ...What am I doing...?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What do you mean? That's impossible.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Your herd is shrinking.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: The initial attack was ferocious and terrifying, but... We're not really sure why, but our scouts report their numbers aren't growing.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Unfortunately, the group that suffered the most from this tactic was the Reunion squad that sustained the initial attack.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Who? Who did this? The L. G. D.? The L. G. D. could never suppress my herd!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: But our people...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I took the L. G. D.'s tactics and equipment into consideration. Facing my herd should have delayed them at least two days. So who is it that's done this?!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: People in black raincoats.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Captain!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Crossbowmen, reform the squad! Mine and a few other teams have scooped up a lot of Mephisto's people.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...Why?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Together, we can hold back the L. G. D.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust, Faust... are you hurt?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: (Why did you leave back there?)

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...Because I had to.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: And I'm glad to see how many of our people you've brought back with you. You'll put them to good use against the L. G. D. I'm sure?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: They won't attack us, but I can't control them. I've been wracking my brain over it.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: There aren't many left though.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: We will need more of our people to protect us. We must defeat those L. G. D.s if we're going to escape.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Mephisto, don't use those Arts again.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But didn't you say we have to survive, Faust? Isn't that what's most important?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...Then why did you...?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Why did you say you would die for that monster, back at the L. G. D. Headquarters?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Crossbowmen.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Ready.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Take him.
